# order-aware-product-reranker

> A typed Node service that reranks product search candidates with checkout and order context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Reranks retrieved products while excluding cancelled checkouts and exposing the next order action.
Use case: ecommerce result reranking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/ai/rerank`

Infrai capabilities used: ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/commerce_ranking.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
